title: op.lnot immediate fast arm in a hot dispatch handler
cut_commit_subject: perf(exec): answer immediate `!` operands without the cold-dispatch protocol
decision_reason: Every threshold passes except one: the complex-operand types regress 2.2%-5.6% whole-case (2.0%-11.7% on the marginal op cost), stably, in both independent scans and in all four build combinations. The revert clause is `complex types regress >= 1%`.

escalation_arithmetic_recorded_before_th.reason: multiple measured buckets are one routing protocol, not independently modified mechanisms

weighted_model_vs_measured.method: per-tag measured delta (P7-61 section 6.1/6.2) x that workload's own operand tag census (P7-60 section 2.3) / that workload's cycles

disassembly.complex_fallback: indirect cold_table[pc[0]] (adrp/add +0xa08), 8 insn on the miss path

non_target_hot_handler_bodies.note: normalised bodies fall into exactly two variants and P0-a is identical to P1-b while P0-b is identical to P1-a, i.e. the variation is the build lottery already present within P0, not the cut
non_target_hot_handler_bodies.two_variant_difference: a 4-instruction schedule swap plus x9/x10 register exchange in the cold_table indirect hop; same insn count

gates.note: run on the cut (f09d89ef), not after the revert; test262/ is not checked out in any worktree, so the corpus was read through read-only symlinks to the integration tree and the gitlink stayed clean

root_cause_of_the_failed_threshold.measured: +8.00 instructions per `!` on every one of 14 complex cases
root_cause_of_the_failed_threshold.mechanism: the hot handler's own miss path: load top tag, compare, fall through, re-load pc[0], materialise the cold_table base, second table load, second indirect branch to the cold shell the first branch used to reach
root_cause_of_the_failed_threshold.why_it_reads_as_2_to_5_pct: the synthetic cases are tight loops in which lnot is about 40% of all work

not_established: no variant with a dedicated directly-tail-called cold handler was written or measured
the +1.4 cyc was not decomposed (no br_mis_pred_retired, no ARM SPE)
the nan-boxing representation was checked semantically and by disassembly only, never timed
product corpus is still Octane-derived only; no Node app, no minified bundle
zlib's four-combination spread (0.78%) exceeds the 0.15% the model predicts for it
no per-workload probe isolating the complex regression; splay -0.04% is model plus score agreement
no qjs-side controlled A/B; qjs appears only in the semantic oracle
